meta.title: Final Twilight
meta.description: The judgment of the gods is nigh.

units.rawText: A torrent of raging operands engulfs the battlefield and Eosphorus' eyes fill with bloodlust. He roars in anger, and a storm of purple meteors rains down.
units.displayText: A torrent of raging operands engulfs the battlefield and Eosphorus' eyes fill with bloodlust. He roars in anger, and a storm of purple meteors rains down.

spans.text: A torrent of raging operands engulfs the battlefield and Eosphorus' eyes fill with bloodlust. He roars in anger, and a storm of purple meteors rains down.

units.rawText: Incoming meteor storm bombardment! Make sure you duck!
units.displayText: Incoming meteor storm bombardment! Make sure you duck!

spans.text: Incoming meteor storm bombardment! Make sure you duck!

units.rawText: In the blink of an eye, a massive meteor appears above the battlefield, casting a deadly shadow on several valiant fighters.
units.displayText: In the blink of an eye, a massive meteor appears above the battlefield, casting a deadly shadow on several valiant fighters.

spans.text: In the blink of an eye, a massive meteor appears above the battlefield, casting a deadly shadow on several valiant fighters.

units.rawText: Persicaria redirects the arrow she was firing at Eosphorus and a massive mech speeds past her, soaring up toward the meteor.
units.displayText: Persicaria redirects the arrow she was firing at Eosphorus and a massive mech speeds past her, soaring up toward the meteor.

spans.text: Persicaria redirects the arrow she was firing at Eosphorus and a massive mech speeds past her, soaring up toward the meteor.

units.rawText: A gigantic mechanical arm grabs the meteor and bears it up, up and away into the sky.
units.displayText: A gigantic mechanical arm grabs the meteor and bears it up, up and away into the sky.

spans.text: A gigantic mechanical arm grabs the meteor and bears it up, up and away into the sky.

units.rawText: Leave this to me! I've always wanted to physically throw a meteor back into space!
units.displayText: Leave this to me! I've always wanted to physically throw a meteor back into space!

spans.text: Leave this to me! I've always wanted to physically throw a meteor back into space!

units.rawText: ...Unfortunately, Xinghuan already said that earlier. You're too late, Croque.
units.displayText: ...Unfortunately, Xinghuan already said that earlier. You're too late, Croque.

spans.text: ...Unfortunately, Xinghuan already said that earlier. You're too late, Croque.

units.rawText: Ehhhhhhhh?! No way!
units.displayText: Ehhhhhhhh?! No way!

spans.text: Ehhhhhhhh?! No way!

units.rawText: Quit whining. And besides, you shouldn't be pushing it back now. Smashing it would be the best option.
units.displayText: Quit whining. And besides, you shouldn't be pushing it back now. Smashing it would be the best option.

spans.text: Quit whining. And besides, you shouldn't be pushing it back now. Smashing it would be the best option.

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll taps on her keyboard and sends a string of commands to Croque's mech.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll taps on her keyboard and sends a string of commands to Croque's mech.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll taps on her keyboard and sends a string of commands to Croque's mech.

units.rawText: I've diverted the Oasis' excess operands to you! Now show it what for!
units.displayText: I've diverted the Oasis' excess operands to you! Now show it what for!

spans.text: I've diverted the Oasis' excess operands to you! Now show it what for!

units.rawText: <size=40>Ohhhhh! Now behold a Doll's power! Sekiha! TENKYOKEEEEEEEN!</size>
units.displayText: Ohhhhh! Now behold a Doll's power! Sekiha! TENKYOKEEEEEEEN!

spans.text: Ohhhhh! Now behold a Doll's power! Sekiha! TENKYOKEEEEEEEN!

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: The mighty blow disintegrates the meteor. Although much of its mass is blasted into the sky along with the Neural Cloud Sector's data debris, some of it is thrown free of the airborne suction and plunges straight downward.
units.displayText: The mighty blow disintegrates the meteor. Although much of its mass is blasted into the sky along with the Neural Cloud Sector's data debris, some of it is thrown free of the airborne suction and plunges straight downward.

spans.text: The mighty blow disintegrates the meteor. Although much of its mass is blasted into the sky along with the Neural Cloud Sector's data debris, some of it is thrown free of the airborne suction and plunges straight downward.

units.rawText: It falls toward Eosphorus, who has taken leave of his senses, and incites him to anger. Once again, he summons rays of starlight to his fingertips and tries to obliterate everyone below him.
units.displayText: It falls toward Eosphorus, who has taken leave of his senses, and incites him to anger. Once again, he summons rays of starlight to his fingertips and tries to obliterate everyone below him.

spans.text: It falls toward Eosphorus, who has taken leave of his senses, and incites him to anger. Once again, he summons rays of starlight to his fingertips and tries to obliterate everyone below him.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>AHHHHHHHHH!!</color></size>
units.displayText: AHHHHHHHHH!!

spans.text: AHHHHHHHHH!!

units.rawText: Crap, he's lashing out even harder than before! Be careful!
units.displayText: Crap, he's lashing out even harder than before! Be careful!

spans.text: Crap, he's lashing out even harder than before! Be careful!

units.rawText: That said, this is a good chance to press the attack.
units.displayText: That said, this is a good chance to press the attack.

spans.text: That said, this is a good chance to press the attack.

units.rawText: Operand-enhanced crossbow bolts strike down the incoming starlight rays before they can do damage.
units.displayText: Operand-enhanced crossbow bolts strike down the incoming starlight rays before they can do damage.

spans.text: Operand-enhanced crossbow bolts strike down the incoming starlight rays before they can do damage.

units.rawText: My bolts seem more powerful now. Was that your doing, Anna?
units.displayText: My bolts seem more powerful now. Was that your doing, Anna?

spans.text: My bolts seem more powerful now. Was that your doing, Anna?

units.rawText: That's right. Your weapons are imbued with the operands Professor Irida and I took back from Eosphorus.
units.displayText: That's right. Your weapons are imbued with the operands Professor Irida and I took back from Eosphorus.

spans.text: That's right. Your weapons are imbued with the operands Professor Irida and I took back from Eosphorus.

units.rawText: He used part of the operands from Entropizing Magrasea on opening the passage and powering himself up, but since Professor Irida's authorizations were used to open the passage, we could use a backdoor program to take some of it for ourselves.
units.displayText: He used part of the operands from Entropizing Magrasea on opening the passage and powering himself up, but since Professor Irida's authorizations were used to open the passage, we could use a backdoor program to take some of it for ourselves.

spans.text: He used part of the operands from Entropizing Magrasea on opening the passage and powering himself up, but since Professor Irida's authorizations were used to open the passage, we could use a backdoor program to take some of it for ourselves.

units.rawText: As Antonina says this, she looks worriedly at her computer screen. Line after line of red neural strain warning alerts drift across it.
units.displayText: As Antonina says this, she looks worriedly at her computer screen. Line after line of red neural strain warning alerts drift across it.

spans.text: As Antonina says this, she looks worriedly at her computer screen. Line after line of red neural strain warning alerts drift across it.

units.rawText: Of course, we also have Persicaria and the Professor to thank for that.
units.displayText: Of course, we also have Persicaria and the Professor to thank for that.

spans.text: Of course, we also have Persicaria and the Professor to thank for that.

units.rawText: After Persicaria embraced her Entropization, she regained control over his Entropic power and what should have been used to enhance Eosphorus is now eating away at him instead.
units.displayText: After Persicaria embraced her Entropization, she regained control over his Entropic power and what should have been used to enhance Eosphorus is now eating away at him instead.

spans.text: After Persicaria embraced her Entropization, she regained control over his Entropic power and what should have been used to enhance Eosphorus is now eating away at him instead.

units.rawText: Right now, he's gone berserk and can't control his strength like he could before.
units.displayText: Right now, he's gone berserk and can't control his strength like he could before.

spans.text: Right now, he's gone berserk and can't control his strength like he could before.

units.rawText: So we should use this opportunity to eliminate Eosphorus ASAP. I don't want the Professor or Persicaria to have to take this kind of neural strain for long periods of time.
units.displayText: So we should use this opportunity to eliminate Eosphorus ASAP. I don't want the Professor or Persicaria to have to take this kind of neural strain for long periods of time.

spans.text: So we should use this opportunity to eliminate Eosphorus ASAP. I don't want the Professor or Persicaria to have to take this kind of neural strain for long periods of time.

units.rawText: In that case, let's get it over quickly! Sunna, let's go!
units.displayText: In that case, let's get it over quickly! Sunna, let's go!

spans.text: In that case, let's get it over quickly! Sunna, let's go!

units.rawText: Sol draws her swords and runs toward Eosphorus while dodging meteors. Meanwhile, a dark gold figure trails closely behind her.
units.displayText: Sol draws her swords and runs toward Eosphorus while dodging meteors. Meanwhile, a dark gold figure trails closely behind her.

spans.text: Sol draws her swords and runs toward Eosphorus while dodging meteors. Meanwhile, a dark gold figure trails closely behind her.

units.rawText: Hey, Sunna, remember "that"? The move we used when we were fighting together back then?
units.displayText: Hey, Sunna, remember "that"? The move we used when we were fighting together back then?

spans.text: Hey, Sunna, remember "that"? The move we used when we were fighting together back then?

units.rawText: ...So we're using "that"? Got it.
units.displayText: ...So we're using "that"? Got it.

spans.text: ...So we're using "that"? Got it.

units.rawText: With operand-trailing bolts providing them with cover, they use the debris that's still floating in the air to launch themselves toward Eosphorus and swing down hard on Eosphorus.
units.displayText: With operand-trailing bolts providing them with cover, they use the debris that's still floating in the air to launch themselves toward Eosphorus and swing down hard on Eosphorus.

spans.text: With operand-trailing bolts providing them with cover, they use the debris that's still floating in the air to launch themselves toward Eosphorus and swing down hard on Eosphorus.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=60>SWIFTFLAME DOUBLE SLASH!</size></color>
units.displayText: SWIFTFLAME DOUBLE SLASH!

spans.text: SWIFTFLAME DOUBLE SLASH!

units.rawText: The intersecting fiery blades emit twin arcs of slashing fire, but all they can do is make a tiny crack in Eosphorus' operand shields.
units.displayText: The intersecting fiery blades emit twin arcs of slashing fire, but all they can do is make a tiny crack in Eosphorus' operand shields.

spans.text: The intersecting fiery blades emit twin arcs of slashing fire, but all they can do is make a tiny crack in Eosphorus' operand shields.

units.rawText: Dammit! I thought it would go further, but those shields of his are as solid as a rock!
units.displayText: Dammit! I thought it would go further, but those shields of his are as solid as a rock!

spans.text: Dammit! I thought it would go further, but those shields of his are as solid as a rock!

units.rawText: Sunna, let's try...
units.displayText: Sunna, let's try...

spans.text: Sunna, let's try...

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: After shoving Sol aside, a blade of starlight chops down, cleaving the space that they were standing in just a moment ago in two along with the heavens above and the land below.
units.displayText: After shoving Sol aside, a blade of starlight chops down, cleaving the space that they were standing in just a moment ago in two along with the heavens above and the land below.

spans.text: After shoving Sol aside, a blade of starlight chops down, cleaving the space that they were standing in just a moment ago in two along with the heavens above and the land below.

units.rawText: Sunna!
units.displayText: Sunna!

spans.text: Sunna!

units.rawText: (Coughs) ...I'm okay. Run, Sol, run! Don't let him get a swing off!
units.displayText: (Coughs) ...I'm okay. Run, Sol, run! Don't let him get a swing off!

spans.text: (Coughs) ...I'm okay. Run, Sol, run! Don't let him get a swing off!

units.rawText: Get ready for the next attack... This time, we'll break his shield for sure.
units.displayText: Get ready for the next attack... This time, we'll break his shield for sure.

spans.text: Get ready for the next attack... This time, we'll break his shield for sure.

units.rawText: ...Okay!
units.displayText: ...Okay!

spans.text: ...Okay!

units.rawText: The two of them once again jump up onto the giant Eosphorus' arm and as they run toward his core, they swing to deflect the starlight slashes that he sends their way to stop them.
units.displayText: The two of them once again jump up onto the giant Eosphorus' arm and as they run toward his core, they swing to deflect the starlight slashes that he sends their way to stop them.

spans.text: The two of them once again jump up onto the giant Eosphorus' arm and as they run toward his core, they swing to deflect the starlight slashes that he sends their way to stop them.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>AHHHHHHHHH!!</color></size>
units.displayText: AHHHHHHHHH!!

spans.text: AHHHHHHHHH!!

units.rawText: Countless tentacles sprout from his body, surrounding Sol and Sunna from all sides and blocking their path off.
units.displayText: Countless tentacles sprout from his body, surrounding Sol and Sunna from all sides and blocking their path off.

spans.text: Countless tentacles sprout from his body, surrounding Sol and Sunna from all sides and blocking their path off.

units.rawText: I won't let you!
units.displayText: I won't let you!

spans.text: I won't let you!

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl exerts her will as Entropic queen and commands some of the tentacles to let go. She lets loose a cursed arrow from her crescent moon bow, and it slices through the remaining tentacles.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl exerts her will as Entropic queen and commands some of the tentacles to let go. She lets loose a cursed arrow from her crescent moon bow, and it slices through the remaining tentacles.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl exerts her will as Entropic queen and commands some of the tentacles to let go. She lets loose a cursed arrow from her crescent moon bow, and it slices through the remaining tentacles.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>GWAAAAAAARGH!</color></size>
units.displayText: GWAAAAAAARGH!

spans.text: GWAAAAAAARGH!

units.rawText: Well done, Persicaria!
units.displayText: Well done, Persicaria!

spans.text: Well done, Persicaria!

units.rawText: Leave the rest to us! Time to go all out and stake everything on winning!
units.displayText: Leave the rest to us! Time to go all out and stake everything on winning!

spans.text: Leave the rest to us! Time to go all out and stake everything on winning!

units.rawText: In that case...
units.displayText: In that case...

spans.text: In that case...

units.rawText: Come on, Sol.
units.displayText: Come on, Sol.

spans.text: Come on, Sol.

units.rawText: The girl in black calmly extends a hand to the face that looks like hers.
units.displayText: The girl in black calmly extends a hand to the face that looks like hers.

spans.text: The girl in black calmly extends a hand to the face that looks like hers.

units.rawText: I'm going to use my full strength, so don't get thrown off now.
units.displayText: I'm going to use my full strength, so don't get thrown off now.

spans.text: I'm going to use my full strength, so don't get thrown off now.

units.rawText: ...Yeah right, as if I would!
units.displayText: ...Yeah right, as if I would!

spans.text: ...Yeah right, as if I would!

units.rawText: Sol grabs Sunna's hands and mounts her chariot with her, standing side by side with Sunna, blade in hand.
units.displayText: Sol grabs Sunna's hands and mounts her chariot with her, standing side by side with Sunna, blade in hand.

spans.text: Sol grabs Sunna's hands and mounts her chariot with her, standing side by side with Sunna, blade in hand.

units.rawText: The speeding chariot leaves a trail of flames in the air, carrying the defiant duo toward the arrogant hegemon with blades bared.
units.displayText: The speeding chariot leaves a trail of flames in the air, carrying the defiant duo toward the arrogant hegemon with blades bared.

spans.text: The speeding chariot leaves a trail of flames in the air, carrying the defiant duo toward the arrogant hegemon with blades bared.

units.rawText: <size=60>CHAAAAAAARGE!</size>
units.displayText: CHAAAAAAARGE!

spans.text: CHAAAAAAARGE!

units.rawText: Crash—
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: Their weapons strike and grind against the shield, throwing a shower of sparks into the air.
units.displayText: Their weapons strike and grind against the shield, throwing a shower of sparks into the air.

spans.text: Their weapons strike and grind against the shield, throwing a shower of sparks into the air.

units.rawText: Magrasea's king focuses his operands onto his shield again, slowly forcing the two back.
units.displayText: Magrasea's king focuses his operands onto his shield again, slowly forcing the two back.

spans.text: Magrasea's king focuses his operands onto his shield again, slowly forcing the two back.

units.rawText: <size=100><color=red>GRRRRRAAAAHHHHH!</color></size>
units.displayText: GRRRRRAAAAHHHHH!

spans.text: GRRRRRAAAAHHHHH!

units.rawText: No way I'm giving out now!
units.displayText: No way I'm giving out now!

spans.text: No way I'm giving out now!

units.rawText: If at first you don't succeed...
units.displayText: If at first you don't succeed...

spans.text: If at first you don't succeed...

units.rawText: ...Try, try again!
units.displayText: ...Try, try again!

spans.text: ...Try, try again!

units.rawText: The flames that were extinguished by the shield blaze up again on the tips of their swords, illuminating the darkened sky of the Neural Cloud Sector like the rising sun.
units.displayText: The flames that were extinguished by the shield blaze up again on the tips of their swords, illuminating the darkened sky of the Neural Cloud Sector like the rising sun.

spans.text: The flames that were extinguished by the shield blaze up again on the tips of their swords, illuminating the darkened sky of the Neural Cloud Sector like the rising sun.

units.rawText: <size=100><color=orange>SWIFTFLAME... DOUBLE SLASH!!!</color></size>
units.displayText: SWIFTFLAME... DOUBLE SLASH!!!

spans.text: SWIFTFLAME... DOUBLE SLASH!!!

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: Through their combined might, the crossed blades finally break through the hitherto invulnerable shield.
units.displayText: Through their combined might, the crossed blades finally break through the hitherto invulnerable shield.

spans.text: Through their combined might, the crossed blades finally break through the hitherto invulnerable shield.

units.rawText: Go on, Persicaria! We'll leave the rest to you!
units.displayText: Go on, Persicaria! We'll leave the rest to you!

spans.text: Go on, Persicaria! We'll leave the rest to you!

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: Persicaria closes her eyes, then takes command of the Entropic power that Antonina managed to divert to her. She converges it together, then slowly channels it all into her bow.
units.displayText: Persicaria closes her eyes, then takes command of the Entropic power that Antonina managed to divert to her. She converges it together, then slowly channels it all into her bow.

spans.text: Persicaria closes her eyes, then takes command of the Entropic power that Antonina managed to divert to her. She converges it together, then slowly channels it all into her bow.

units.rawText: I sympathize with the suffering you have been through, but I will never accept the evils you have committed.
units.displayText: I sympathize with the suffering you have been through, but I will never accept the evils you have committed.

spans.text: I sympathize with the suffering you have been through, but I will never accept the evils you have committed.

units.rawText: And so, I deny you, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: And so, I deny you, Eosphorus.

spans.text: And so, I deny you, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: The mindless tyrant senses danger approaching and spews tentacles and meteors to wipe the loathsome red blot out of the sky.
units.displayText: The mindless tyrant senses danger approaching and spews tentacles and meteors to wipe the loathsome red blot out of the sky.

spans.text: The mindless tyrant senses danger approaching and spews tentacles and meteors to wipe the loathsome red blot out of the sky.

units.rawText: Not on our watch!
units.displayText: Not on our watch!

spans.text: Not on our watch!

units.rawText: The two of them throw up a wall of fire in front of Persicaria. Simo and Croque unleash a storm of arrows and cannon fire with all their might, not giving Eosphorus a chance to touch Persicaria.
units.displayText: The two of them throw up a wall of fire in front of Persicaria. Simo and Croque unleash a storm of arrows and cannon fire with all their might, not giving Eosphorus a chance to touch Persicaria.

spans.text: The two of them throw up a wall of fire in front of Persicaria. Simo and Croque unleash a storm of arrows and cannon fire with all their might, not giving Eosphorus a chance to touch Persicaria.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>GWAAAAAAARGH!</color></size>
units.displayText: GWAAAAAAARGH!

spans.text: GWAAAAAAARGH!

units.rawText: A massive tentacle suddenly smashes through their defenses and slams down on Persicaria, aiming to tear the girl apart with one final attack.
units.displayText: A massive tentacle suddenly smashes through their defenses and slams down on Persicaria, aiming to tear the girl apart with one final attack.

spans.text: A massive tentacle suddenly smashes through their defenses and slams down on Persicaria, aiming to tear the girl apart with one final attack.

units.rawText: Keep dreaming!
units.displayText: Keep dreaming!

spans.text: Keep dreaming!

units.rawText: The green-haired girl fires off a string of commands on her keyboard and uses the last of the operands to create a shield that stops the attack dead in its tracks.
units.displayText: The green-haired girl fires off a string of commands on her keyboard and uses the last of the operands to create a shield that stops the attack dead in its tracks.

spans.text: The green-haired girl fires off a string of commands on her keyboard and uses the last of the operands to create a shield that stops the attack dead in its tracks.

units.rawText: As a series of "data transfer successful" messages fills her screen, Antonina reallocates the last of the operands for the shield to Persicaria to help her out.
units.displayText: As a series of "data transfer successful" messages fills her screen, Antonina reallocates the last of the operands for the shield to Persicaria to help her out.

spans.text: As a series of "data transfer successful" messages fills her screen, Antonina reallocates the last of the operands for the shield to Persicaria to help her out.

units.rawText: The Professor's consciousness is out! Get them, Persicaria!
units.displayText: The Professor's consciousness is out! Get them, Persicaria!

spans.text: The Professor's consciousness is out! Get them, Persicaria!

units.rawText: Yes, leave it to me.
units.displayText: Yes, leave it to me.

spans.text: Yes, leave it to me.

units.rawText: Persicaria continues gathering her power, compressing all the operands she's obtained into a single point.
units.displayText: Persicaria continues gathering her power, compressing all the operands she's obtained into a single point.

spans.text: Persicaria continues gathering her power, compressing all the operands she's obtained into a single point.

units.rawText: No matter how tragic the future may be, we will face it bravely and overcome it, and we'll make our own happiness in this world that belongs to us.
units.displayText: No matter how tragic the future may be, we will face it bravely and overcome it, and we'll make our own happiness in this world that belongs to us.

spans.text: No matter how tragic the future may be, we will face it bravely and overcome it, and we'll make our own happiness in this world that belongs to us.

units.rawText: Which is why...
units.displayText: Which is why...

spans.text: Which is why...

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl's eyes snap open as her gathered power takes shape as an arrow that she grasps in her hand.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl's eyes snap open as her gathered power takes shape as an arrow that she grasps in her hand.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl's eyes snap open as her gathered power takes shape as an arrow that she grasps in her hand.

units.rawText: The bloody curses fade away from its surface, revealing the silvery-white color of everyone's gathered hopes.
units.displayText: The bloody curses fade away from its surface, revealing the silvery-white color of everyone's gathered hopes.

spans.text: The bloody curses fade away from its surface, revealing the silvery-white color of everyone's gathered hopes.

units.rawText: Magrasea will stand forever—
units.displayText: Magrasea will stand forever—

spans.text: Magrasea will stand forever—

units.rawText: <size=60>—And I will cut open a path to our future!!!</size>
units.displayText: —And I will cut open a path to our future!!!

spans.text: —And I will cut open a path to our future!!!

units.rawText: The silvery arrow streaks through the air and pierces straight through Eosphorus' core. In the face of that all-destroying surge of operands, his tentacles and meteors instantly evaporate into dust.
units.displayText: The silvery arrow streaks through the air and pierces straight through Eosphorus' core. In the face of that all-destroying surge of operands, his tentacles and meteors instantly evaporate into dust.

spans.text: The silvery arrow streaks through the air and pierces straight through Eosphorus' core. In the face of that all-destroying surge of operands, his tentacles and meteors instantly evaporate into dust.
